auth.description: Shopify Admin API access token, sent as the whole value of X-Shopify-Access-Token, with read_orders, read_products, write_products, read_customers and read_inventory scopes
auth.name: shopify.access_token
auth.subject: unstated

config.help: The part of your `myshopify.com` address before the dot — for `acme.myshopify.com`, this is `acme`. Not your custom storefront domain
config.label: Shop name
config.name: shop

config.help: From your custom app's API credentials page in the Shopify admin. Starts with `shpat_`, and Shopify shows it once
config.label: Admin API access token
config.name: access_token

description: Shopify Admin REST API: read orders, products, customers and inventory levels, and update a product

operations.description: Get one order by id, with its line items, totals, fulfilment and financial status, and the customer and addresses attached to it. The response carries personal data: the customer's name, email, phone and shipping address

params.description: The order's numeric id — not its `#1001` order name
params.name: order_id

cancelled_at.description: When the order was cancelled, or null. This, not a status value, is how a cancelled order is identified

closed_at.description: When the order was archived, or null

created_at.description: ISO 8601 with the shop's UTC offset, not a Unix timestamp

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the amounts are in. Read it before rendering money — a shop may sell in several

customer.description: The buyer, or null on a guest checkout with no customer record. Personal data

fulfillment_status.description: `fulfilled`, `partial`, `restocked` — or **null**, which is Shopify's spelling for unfulfilled. Null is the common case on a new order, so test for it explicitly

id.description: The order's numeric id — what this operation takes

line_items.description: What was ordered: each entry carries `id`, `title`, `quantity`, `price` (a decimal string), `sku`, `variant_id` and `product_id`

name.description: The merchant-facing order name, e.g. `#1001`. This is what a human recognises and it does NOT address this endpoint

note.description: The merchant's own note on the order, or null

order_number.description: The number inside that name, without the prefix

shipping_address.description: Where it ships: `{name, address1, address2, city, province, country, zip, phone}`. Personal data, and null for a digital order

tags.description: A COMMA-SEPARATED STRING, not an array — e.g. `"imported, vip"`. Split it yourself

total_price.description: The order total **as a decimal string**, e.g. `"409.94"`. Shopify's properties table states no JSON type for it and its example shows a quoted value; convert before comparing

operations.description: Get one product by id, with its title, description, status, vendor, options, variants and images

params.description: The product's numeric id — not its URL handle
params.name: product_id

body_html.description: The description as HTML, or null

handle.description: The URL slug on the storefront. Derived from the title, and it does NOT address this endpoint

images.description: Each `{id, src, alt, width, height, position, variant_ids}`

options.description: The variant axes, each `{id, name, position, values}`

published_at.description: When it was published to the online store, or **null** for an active-but-unpublished product that no shopper can see

status.description: `active`, `draft` or `archived`. Only `active` can be sold, but see `published_at`

tags.description: A COMMA-SEPARATED STRING, not an array

variants.description: The purchasable variants, each with `id`, `title`, `price` (a decimal string), `sku`, `inventory_item_id` and `inventory_quantity`. `inventory_item_id` is what `shopify-inventory-level-list` reports stock against

operations.description: Rename a product. The new title is live on the public storefront as soon as this returns, on every sales channel the product is published to. Shopify applies only the fields sent, so nothing else about the product changes

params.description: The numeric id of the product to update
params.name: product_id

params.description: The product's new title, as customers see it. Must not be blank
params.name: title

handle.description: The storefront slug, which is not re-derived by a rename and so still reflects the previous title

tags.description: A comma-separated string, not an array

title.description: The title **after** the update. Compare it against what was sent — a 200 alone does not prove the change applied

variants.description: Unchanged by this call. Note that each variant's `title` is the variant's own, not the product's

operations.description: Get one customer by id: name, email, phone, default address, marketing consent state and order count. This is personal data about a named individual — read it only when the task needs it, and do not repeat it further than the task requires

addresses.description: Every saved address, each `{id, address1, city, province, country, zip, phone, default}`. Personal data

default_address.description: The one marked default, in the same shape. Null when the customer has none

email.description: Personal data. Null for a customer created without one

email_marketing_consent.description: `{state, opt_in_level, consent_updated_at}` — whether this person may be marketed to. `state` is `subscribed`, `not_subscribed`, `pending` or `unsubscribed`, and it is the field to check before any send

last_order_id.description: The id of their most recent order, or null. Documented, unlike the aggregate counts this schema omits

note.description: The merchant's own note, or null

state.description: The customer's account state — `disabled`, `invited`, `enabled` or `declined`. It is about the storefront account, not about marketing consent

tags.description: A COMMA-SEPARATED STRING, not an array

verified_email.description: Whether the address was confirmed. False does not mean invalid

operations.description: List the inventory levels held at one location — the available quantity per inventory item. Returns the first page only, so a location stocking more items than one page holds is reported incompletely

params.description: The numeric id of the location whose stock to list
params.name: location_id

inventory_levels.description: One entry per inventory item stocked at this location. First page only — a location with more items than one page holds is reported incompletely, and nothing in the body says so

available.description: Units available to sell now. Can be negative when the shop oversold, and **null** for an item whose inventory is not tracked

inventory_item_id.description: The join key back to a product variant's `inventory_item_id`. This response carries no product or variant name
